repo.description: Chart repository URL, classic HTTP(S) or oci://.

version.description: Chart version; the latest available if omitted.

values.description: Values files merged into the chart's defaults, in order, like repeated "helm template -f".

namespace.description: Namespace templates are rendered as if installed into; "default" if omitted.

release-name.description: Release name templates are rendered as if installed under; "release-name" if omitted.

kube-version.description: Kubernetes version templates are rendered for, e.g. "1.31.0".

extraComponents.description: CycloneDX components appended to the SBOM as-is, for anything rendering can't discover. A missing bom-ref defaults to the purl.
